94.old: Delta adopted a new Official Community Plan in 2024. Zoning and what the plan says can be different for each lot.
94.new: A new Official Community Plan was adopted by Delta in 2024. Each lot can have different zoning, and what the plan says about it can also differ.

95.old: Lots zoned for single detached or duplex homes can have up to 3 units (lots up to 280 square metres) or 4 units (larger lots), plus a secondary suite and coach or garden suites within the unit limits.
95.new: A lot zoned for single detached or duplex use can have 3 units when it is no larger than 280 square metres, and 4 units when it is bigger. Coach or garden suites and a secondary suite are allowed too, as long as they stay within those unit limits.

96.old: Low and waterfront lots may have a rule on the title (a covenant) that sets how high the living space must be built. Minimum flood elevations are shown on DeltaMap.
96.new: A covenant on the title of a low or waterfront lot may set how high the living space has to be built. DeltaMap shows the minimum flood elevations.
